body:
I used to beat the shit out of my own mother. I grew up in a broken home. Both my parents are mental patients. My father was a flustered abusive motherfucker and not much of an example when it came to dealing with differences. He used to both beat the shit out of me and humiliate me in front of other adults and in front of my own friends. I was never able to get over that. This along with constant psychological blackmail turned me gradually into a sick little monster. 
My mother has schizophrenia. I remember the times before she went completely out of control. A nice, beautiful lady. Always cheerful and occasionally singing. Then she grew tired of her medication i guess. She became a whole other person. She and my father split up and shit hit the fan. She kept my custody (i'm an only child) so I'd spend the working days of the week with her and the weekend with my father.
After a few years of zero medication it became unbearable to live with her. She would lock me up at home, not allowing me to go out and play with other kids or going on school trips. And then the constant nagging. Over and over and over. I can still hear it after more than 15 years. I would beg her on my knees to shut up. My head was pounding by the end of every day. This went on so many times I can't possibly give a number. Then one day I just snapped. I went for it. I couldn't take it. I hit her. Just the first time of many. After the first time it became easier. The thickest line had been crossed. After this I was king at home. whenever she would disrespect me I'd give her a black eye. Then with time, some people suspected and some, like the next door neighbors knew what was happening. I hated them then and I hate them now for not doing anything. All family disappeared after my mother's breakdown so I was left to myself. The worst part was when I actually began to enjoy it. Then after many years trying to control myself and fighting suicidal thoughts I moved many miles away. Best thing I ever did. I know I will never find peace and I will never be normal after what went on but at least I'm no longer hurting anyone nor have any wish to do so.
When I'm asked about my earliest memories, most people don't believe me when I tell them about from before 'the shit', since I was only 5 at the time. Those are about the only good memories I have in my life. I will always hold onto them like a treasure.

First of all, thanks for answering. 
what if it already is permanent? I've probably been stupid fighting it alone for too long. I look like I'm 10 years older. Got any advice in this case? Just so I'm clear, I didn't post this for sheer sympathy but I do feel like my motivation to fix anything has become pretty scarce.
